def: to decease (literally) in company with, or (figuratively), similarly to

occurrences.text: But he spake the more vehemently, If I should die with thee, I will not deny thee in any wise. Likewise also said they all.
I speak not this to condemn you: for I have said before, that ye are in our hearts to die and live with you.
It is a faithful saying: For if we be dead with him, we shall also live with him:
